column1: # 073.2 - Doran zdradza corce plan zemsty (Quentyn do Daenerys - prolog/m23).

column15: {=ARM_KR_073_2_U}In the quiet of the Water Gardens, Doran Martell at last speaks plainly to his daughter. For years he has smiled at the Lannisters and waited, never forgetting his sister Elia, murdered with her children in the Red Keep during the Sack of King's Landing.
column16: {=ARM_KR_073_2_L}He shows Arianne a pact sealed long ago with the exiled dragon kings. Her brother Quentyn has already sailed east in secret to win the hand of Daenerys Targaryen and bring her dragons west.

column1: # 074.1 - zapowiedz okna ROT King in the North (JonEvent); swiat bez zmian.

column15: {=ARM_KR_074_1_U}A letter sealed with pink wax reaches Castle Black. Ramsay Bolton boasts that Stannis Baratheon lies dead beneath Winterfell, and demands that the Lord Commander send back his runaway bride and his creature Reek, or he will ride north and cut out Jon Snow's heart.
column16: {=ARM_KR_074_1_L}No other raven confirms the king's fall, and Jon cannot tell truth from cruelty. He reads the letter aloud in the shieldhall and vows to ride south himself; some brothers hear only a broken oath.

column16: {=ARM_KR_074_1a_L}Other ravens soon confirm it: the king truly is dead. Jon reads the letter aloud in the shieldhall and vows to ride south himself, and some of his brothers hear only a broken oath.

column1: # 074.1b - Stannis rozbity pod Winterfell (081.2 lekka), ale zywy.

column15: {=ARM_KR_074_1b_U}A letter sealed with pink wax reaches Castle Black. Ramsay Bolton boasts that Stannis Baratheon lies dead beneath Winterfell, and demands that the Lord Commander send back his runaway bride and his creature Reek, or he will ride north and cut out Jon Snow's heart.
column16: {=ARM_KR_074_1b_L}Stannis lives, but his host lies broken in the snow, and the boast holds more truth than Jon would like. He reads the letter aloud in the shieldhall and vows to ride south himself.

column1: # 075.1 - Synowie Harpii (frakcja ROT sons_of_the_harpy) - banda przy Meereen; dla slugi Daenerys zadanie albo zakladnicy.

column15: {=ARM_KR_075_1_U}Each night Meereen finds more of its defenders in the gutters: Unsullied and freedmen with their throats cut and a golden harpy mask left beside them. The old masters smile in their pyramids, and no one ever sees who wears the masks.
column16: {=ARM_KR_075_1_L}Then a dragon kills a child in the hills, and the father lays the bones at the queen's feet. Daenerys chains two of her dragons in the dark beneath the pyramid. The third has flown, and does not come back.
column18: {=ARM_KR_075_1_Q}How will you help the queen against the Sons of the Harpy?

column1: # 075.2 - slub z Hizdahrem; idzie za m24 (CanonCompanions marry:lord_1_14 przy RamsayEvent).

column15: {=ARM_KR_075_2_U}To end the killings, Daenerys gives her hand to Hizdahr zo Loraq, a noble of one of the oldest Ghiscari houses. He swears that the Harpy will lay down its knives, and on the day of the wedding not one freedman dies in the streets.
column16: {=ARM_KR_075_2_L}The price is the reopening of the fighting pits, which the queen once closed in disgust. Meereen celebrates, the masters smile, and the queen's oldest knights watch her new husband very carefully.

column1: # 075.2a - wiersz m24 pominiety (Hizdahra nie ma): pokoj bez slubu.

column15: {=ARM_KR_075_2a_U}Daenerys refuses the marriage the masters offer her. She buys peace the hard way instead: the fighting pits open again, the great houses send their sons to the pyramid as pledges, and slowly the killings stop.
column16: {=ARM_KR_075_2a_L}The harpy masks vanish from the streets of Meereen, but no one in the city believes this peace will last any longer than the patience of the queen.

column1: # 075.3 - smierc Quentyna; idzie za m23 (die przy JonEvent) - okno opowiada to, co CanonCompanions juz wykonal.

column15: {=ARM_KR_075_3_U}Quentyn Martell came to Meereen with an old pact and too few swords, and found the queen had no use for either. Unwilling to sail home with nothing, the Dornish prince slips by night into the pit where her dragons lie chained, sure that the blood of the dragon runs in him.
column16: {=ARM_KR_075_3_L}The dragons wake. Quentyn dies of his burns three days later, and both dragons break loose into the city. In Sunspear, his father hears the news in silence.

column1: # 076.1 - Astapor traci ludzi (ksiega ludzi, do puli regionu), bezpieczenstwo i lojalnosc; wlasciciel bez zmian.

column15: {=ARM_KR_076_1_U}The council Daenerys left behind in Astapor did not last. A butcher named Cleon seized the city, put the old masters to the sword and named himself king, then marched his new slave soldiers against Yunkai and lost them all.
column16: {=ARM_KR_076_1_L}Now Astapor eats itself. Its markets stand empty and its streets burn, and long lines of refugees walk north along the coast road towards Meereen, carrying a sickness with them.

column1: # 076.2 - zaraza (uchwyt kod:zaraza: ludzie Meereen przez ksiege ludzi, ranni w oddzialach obok); wybor dla slugi Daenerys.

column15: {=ARM_KR_076_2_U}The refugees from Astapor camp in their thousands beneath the walls of Meereen, and among them rides the pale mare, a bloody flux that empties a man in days. Beyond the camp, the armies of Yunkai and their hired companies dig in for a siege.
column16: {=ARM_KR_076_2_L}Inside the walls the queen must choose between mercy and her own people. The flux crosses the walls anyway, carried by the healers she sends out, and soon it reaches the camps of the besiegers too.
column18: {=ARM_KR_076_2_Q}The refugees are dying at the gates. What do you counsel the queen?

column15: {=ARM_KR_081_1_U}The march on Winterfell dies in the snow. Horses freeze where they stand, the supply carts are lost, and sellswords slip away by night. Melisandre tells the king that the storm will break only for a gift of king's blood, and Stannis listens.
column16: {=ARM_KR_081_1_L}At dawn his men raise a stake in the middle of the camp. Princess Shireen, the gentle girl with the greyscale scar, is led out between the guards, still asking for her father.
column18: {=ARM_KR_081_1_Q}You stand at the side of the king as the stake is raised. What do you do?

column1: # 081.2 lekka (obie): Stannis zlamany i ranny, zyje (zapas: swiat inny niz w serialu albo klucze NIE). Melisandre do rodu Jona.

column15: {=ARM_KR_081_2_U}What is left of the host goes forward anyway, and the Bolton horse rides out of Winterfell to meet it. The knights of the burning heart break in the snow beneath the walls, and the Boltons hunt the survivors through the frozen woods.
column16: {=ARM_KR_081_2_L}Stannis is carried from the field more dead than alive by the last of his knights. Those sworn to avenge Renly find only an empty camp and a trail of blood. Melisandre rides for Castle Black.

column16: {=ARM_KR_081_2b_L}He is found among the frozen dead when the snow is cleared. His cousin Ser Andrew Estermont inherits a broken cause and an empty treasury, and Melisandre is already riding for Castle Black.

column1: # 082.1 - wizja Brana u trojokiej wrony (po 066.1). Bez Brana okno przepada, a prawde niesie 082.2 (Sam).

column15: {=ARM_KR_082_1_U}In the roots beneath the weirwood, Bran rides the old visions back to the red mountains of Dorne. He sees his father as a young man, fighting the last knights of the Kingsguard before a lonely tower, and then climbing its stair alone.
column16: {=ARM_KR_082_1_L}At the top lies Lyanna Stark in a bed of blood. With the last of her strength she puts her newborn son in Ned's arms and begs him to keep the boy safe. Bran knows that child's face. It is Jon.

column1: # 082.2 - Sam w Cytadeli (ukryty od m21); po oknie wraca na mape: Winterfell, gdy trzyma je Polnoc, inaczej Czarny Zamek.

column15: {=ARM_KR_082_2_U}In a corner of the Citadel library, Gilly reads aloud from the diary of a long dead High Septon. Among his complaints about his bowels sits one dry line: he annulled the marriage of Prince Rhaegar and wed him in secret to another woman in Dorne.
column16: {=ARM_KR_082_2_L}Sam barely hears it at first. Later he can think of nothing else. He leaves his chain unfinished, takes a few stolen books and rides north with Gilly and the boy to find Jon.

column1: # 082.2a - Winterfell w rekach Polnocy: Sam wraca do Winterfell.
# 082.3 - Jon poznaje prawde (po spotkaniu z Daenerys - 102.1 w K9).

column15: {=ARM_KR_082_3_U}Beneath Winterfell, before the stone face of Lyanna Stark, Samwell Tarly tells Jon what he found in Oldtown. Jon was never Ned Stark's bastard. He is the son of Rhaegar Targaryen and Lyanna, born in wedlock.
column16: {=ARM_KR_082_3_L}His true name is Aegon, and by the old laws his claim to the Iron Throne stands before that of Daenerys herself. Jon wants none of it. Daenerys, when she learns, says little and forgets nothing.

column1: # 083.1 - ucieczka Sansy do Jona (po JonEvent, przed To Winterfell). Brienne i Podrick - relacje; rod Starkow przez wiersze #move m33/m34 (m107, kr:083.1~0b).

column15: {=ARM_KR_083_1_U}Word that Jon Snow lives and is King in the North travels fast, and Sansa Stark leaves her hiding place to ride for her brother. Her pursuers catch her by a frozen river, and for a moment the long flight seems over.
column16: {=ARM_KR_083_1_L}Then Brienne of Tarth and young Podrick come out of the trees. The hunters die in the snow, and Brienne kneels to offer Sansa the sword she once swore to her mother. This time Sansa accepts it.

column1: # 083.1a - Brienne nie zyje: bez sceny ratunku.

column15: {=ARM_KR_083_1a_U}Word that Jon Snow lives and is King in the North travels fast, and Sansa Stark leaves her hiding place with a handful of loyal guards to ride for her brother.
column16: {=ARM_KR_083_1a_L}The roads are full of deserters and Bolton riders, but her small escort keeps to the hills and the snow covers their tracks. No knight comes to her rescue, and none is needed.

column1: # 083.1b - gracz na Polnocy: na mapie maly oddzial poscigu (pomoc = relacje z Sansa, Jonem i Brienne).
# 083.2 - Sansa u Jona: do rodu Starkow clan_battania_1 (NIE Snow - BastardsEvent niszczy Snow), powrot na mape, jesli ukryta (nr 49).

column15: {=ARM_KR_083_2_U}In the snowy yard of Castle Black, Sansa and Jon hold each other for a long time without a word. They parted as children in Winterfell, a lifetime and two wars ago, and neither of them is the same person now.
column16: {=ARM_KR_083_2_L}Sansa tells him plainly that the North will never be safe while a Bolton sits in their father's hall. She stays at his side as a Stark of Winterfell, and speaks in council as if she had always done so.

column1: # 083.2a - Petyr rzadzi Dolina: wie, dokad pojechala Sansa (nr 91, 105).
# 084.1 - Umberowie przy Boltonach (lekka: relacje; zmiana krolestwa rodu nie ma w slowniku akcji).

column15: {=ARM_KR_084_1_U}Smalljon Umber rides into Winterfell with his banners and a grudge. Jon Snow let the wildlings through the Wall, the same free folk who have burned Umber villages for a thousand years, and Last Hearth will not stand with a king who did that.
column16: {=ARM_KR_084_1_L}He pledges his spears to Ramsay Bolton in the great hall, though not his friendship. Ramsay smiles and calls it an alliance. In the North, everyone remembers on which side the Umbers stood.

column1: # 084.1a - Rickon zyje w ukryciu (nr 26): wraca na mape jako jeniec Ramsaya w Winterfell. Osha (wiersze #move) tylko w tekscie.

column15: {=ARM_KR_084_1a_U}Smalljon Umber rides into Winterfell with a grudge against the king who let the wildlings through the Wall, and a gift to seal a new alliance: a shaggy, wild-eyed boy and the wildling woman who hid him for years.
column16: {=ARM_KR_084_1a_L}The boy is Rickon Stark, the last trueborn son of Eddard. Osha dies trying to save him, and Rickon goes down into the cells of his own home. Ramsay could not have asked for a better hostage.

column1: # 084.2 - poczatek Bitwy Bekartow (BastardsSiegeEvent): Rickon ginie. Wynik bitwy robi ROT.

column15: {=ARM_KR_084_2_U}On the morning of battle, Ramsay walks his captive out between the armies, cuts his bonds and tells Rickon Stark to run to his brother. The boy runs across the frozen field, and Ramsay nocks an arrow and takes his time.
column16: {=ARM_KR_084_2_L}Jon spurs his horse forward alone, leaving his battle line behind. He is a heartbeat too late. Rickon falls a few strides from him, and the King in the North rides at the Bolton host blind with grief.

column1: # 085.1 - Jon zbiera choragwie; miekki cel zbiorki lordow Polnocy pod Winterfell (muster); wasal Polnocy wybiera.

column15: {=ARM_KR_085_1_U}Jon and Sansa ride from hall to hall to raise the North against the Boltons. On Bear Island they are received by its lady, Lyanna Mormont, a girl of ten who questions them sharply about loyalty and then pledges every one of her men.
column16: {=ARM_KR_085_1_L}Her island can spare only a few dozen spears, but she swears each of them fights like ten. A giant and the free folk follow the king, while the Glovers keep their gates shut against the Starks.
column18: {=ARM_KR_085_1_Q}The King in the North calls his banners. What is your answer?

column15: {=ARM_KR_085_1a_U}Jon and Sansa ride from hall to hall to raise the North against the Boltons. On Bear Island the Mormonts pledge what men they have left, though their island is small and their losses in the wars already heavy.
column16: {=ARM_KR_085_1a_L}A giant and the free folk follow the king as well, while the Glovers keep their gates shut against the Starks who failed them. It is a small army for so great a castle.
column18: {=ARM_KR_085_1a_Q}The King in the North calls his banners. What is your answer?

column15: {=ARM_KR_086_1_U}Ellaria Sand and the daughters of Oberyn have waited long enough for Prince Doran to avenge his brother. Behind his back they buy guards, bribe a ship's master and sharpen their knives, while the prince sits among the fountains of the Water Gardens.
column16: {=ARM_KR_086_1_L}Obara Sand walks the gardens with a spear in her hand, Ellaria hides a dagger in her sleeve, and Areo Hotah stands alone behind his prince's chair. By nightfall Dorne will have new masters, unless someone speaks.
column18: {=ARM_KR_086_1_Q}You know of the plot against Prince Doran. What do you do?

column16: {=ARM_KR_086_1b_L}Obara Sand walks the gardens with a spear in her hand, Ellaria hides a dagger in her sleeve, and Areo Hotah stands alone behind his prince's chair. By nightfall Dorne will have new masters, unless someone speaks.

column1: # 086.2 - Myrcella otruta (tylko gdy jest w Dorne po nr 19 i zamach sie udal).

column15: {=ARM_KR_086_2_U}Dorne's new masters have no use for a Lannister hostage, and Myrcella Baratheon is sent home to King's Landing with every honour. On the dock at Sunspear, Ellaria Sand kisses the girl goodbye on the lips, gently, like a mother.
column16: {=ARM_KR_086_2_L}The ship has barely cleared the harbour when Myrcella's nose begins to bleed. She dies before the coast of Dorne fades behind her. Her mother will never forgive Dorne, and never forget.

column1: # 087.1 - Yara (jedna rola Asha/Yara - Yara) do rodu Daenerys; Theon - tekst i relacje, w wariancie a do rodu Daenerys wierszem #move m29 (m107).

column15: {=ARM_KR_087_1_U}Euron Greyjoy has won the Seastone Chair at the kingsmoot, and his niece knows what comes next. Before his men can reach her, Yara Greyjoy takes the best ships of the fleet and the crews still loyal to her, and slips out of harbour by night.
column16: {=ARM_KR_087_1_L}She sails for Slaver's Bay to offer the dragon queen a hundred ships in exchange for help taking back the islands. Whatever became of her brother, he is not with her.

column1: # 087.1a - Theon wolny w rodzie Greyjoyow: plynie z siostra (m107: rod Targaryenow - wiersz #move m29, kr:087.1~a).

column15: {=ARM_KR_087_1a_U}Euron Greyjoy has won the Seastone Chair at the kingsmoot, and his niece and nephew know what comes next. Before his men can reach them, Yara and Theon Greyjoy take the best ships of the fleet and the crews still loyal to them, and slip out of harbour by night.
column16: {=ARM_KR_087_1a_L}They sail for Slaver's Bay to offer the dragon queen a hundred ships in exchange for help taking back the islands. Theon, broken by the Boltons, asks nothing for himself.

column16: {=ARM_KR_906_1_L}Bought and sold in the camps outside besieged Meereen, he talks his way out of his chains and into the Second Sons, and signs the company book with a flourish.
